case_title: GEETA & ORS. v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH & ANR.
neutral_facts: The appellants challenged the proceedings under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking to quash the order dated 18.06.2018 and the entire proceedings in Complaint Case No. 537/2018 under Section 498-A of the Indian Penal Code. The High Court dismissed the application, but the Supreme Court found that the High Court failed to address the factual matrix of the case, including the nature of the complaint, the allegations, the offences under which the prosecution was sought, and the grounds for challenging the proceedings. The case was remanded to the High Court for reconsideration on its merits.
